events.title: Periodic pipe dreams and matrix positroid varieties
events.summary: Explore the mathematical concept of "periodic pipe dreams" and their application in computing fundamental classes of positroid varieties. This seminar delves into geometric interpretations and extends the discussion to related open varieties.
events.experienceId: experience:["ann arbor","east hall","periodic pipe dreams and matrix positroid varieties"]

evidence.description: Fan, Guo, Su and our own Rui Xiong introduced "periodic pipe dreams" to compute fundamental  classes of positroid varieties, as classes on Grassmannians. Their formula is too beautiful to live only in a quotient ring. I'll explain some subtleties in interpreting it geometrically upstairs in the polynomial ring, and extend it to compute classes of other projected Richardson varieties. As in the work of Fan, Guo, Su and Xiong, we will also discuss CSM classes of the related open varieties.  This work is joint with Paul Zinn-Justin.

evidence.description: Planet Ant Theatre presents SHE KILLS MONSTERS by Qui Nguyen, December 4-19, 2026, at Ant Hall. When Agnes Evans loses her teenage sister Tilly, she realizes she barely knew her. Tilly's Dungeons & Dragons notebook pulls Agnes into a fantastical world of epic quests, homicidal fairies, snarling ogres, and 90s pop culture as she tries to reconnect with her sister and find the courage she never knew she had. Equal parts comedy, heartfelt drama, and action-packed adventure, the play celebrates the power of great storytelling and the geek and warrior in all of us.
